objective: Definitive captions-ON acceptance: startup, sustained output, controlled recovery, post-recovery correspondence.
source_passage: Beta7 Sample 3 Weather 360p (station's on-hand speech-bearing program)
matching_rule: Decoded text counts as MATCH for a cue when, after case-folding and collapsing punctuation/whitespace, the decoded text contains at least SIX CONSECUTIVE WORDS that also appear contiguously in the cue text. Prefix-only overlap does not count.
procedure: 1. channel STOPPED; start ONE capture that runs ~420s continuously
2. with capture already running, issue START (capture-before-enable)
4. issue controlled STOP then START (the interruption)
5. keep the SAME capture running through the whole post-recovery window
6. preserve the FIRST cue committed after recovery, plus later snapshots
7. decode the TS; apply the 6-consecutive-word matching rule
success_criteria: >=1 decoded entry matching a preserved cue by the matching rule
caption runtime observed within-capacity with cue count INCREASING after the controlled interruption
post-recovery cue preserved and matched from the outgoing TS
no threshold change, no CPU substitution, no unrelated GPU workload termination
failure_criteria: no decoded text despite cues on air -> FAIL
captions do not resume after the controlled interruption -> FAIL
explicitly_not_claimed: Does not establish long-run stability beyond this window.
